test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A girl spends 80% of her income. If her income increases by 18% and her expenditure increases by 25%, then what is the percentage increase or decrease in her savings (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of expenditure = 80%

Increment in Income = 18%

Increment in expenditure = 25%

**Calculation:**

Let the income of A be 100x

Expenditure = (80% of 100x)

⇒ 80x

Saving = (100x – 80x)

⇒ 20x

When income increased by 18%

New income = 100x × (118/100)

⇒ 118x

When expenditure increased by 25%

New expenditure = 80x × (125/100)

⇒ 100x

New saving = (118x – 100x)

⇒ 18x

Percent decrement = [(20x – 18x)/20x] × 100

⇒ [2x/20x] × 100

⇒ 10%

**∴ The percentage decrease in her savings is 10%**
